name: backend-code
description: Backend service — Lambda handlers and the SAM template that deploys them

scripts.deploy: npm run validate && npm run build && if [ -f samconfig.toml ]; then sam deploy --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM; else sam deploy --guided --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM; fi
scripts.deploy:env: npm run validate && npm run build && . ./.env && sam deploy --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM --parameter-overrides ProjectName="$ProjectName" Environment="$Environment" ApiStageName="$ApiStageName" CognitoUserPoolId="$CognitoUserPoolId" CognitoUserPoolArn="$CognitoUserPoolArn" CognitoUserPoolClientId="$CognitoUserPoolClientId" CognitoClientSecret="$CognitoClientSecret" ResetTokenSecret="$RESET_TOKEN_SECRET" CorsAllowOrigin="$CorsAllowOrigin" LogRetentionInDays="$LogRetentionInDays" LogLevel="$LogLevel" ThrottlingRateLimit="$ThrottlingRateLimit" ThrottlingBurstLimit="$ThrottlingBurstLimit" ManageApiGatewayAccount="$ManageApiGatewayAccount"
scripts.deploy:guided: npm run validate && npm run build && sam deploy --guided --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
